method: Two complete benchmark invocations. Each alternates baseline/current/current/baseline, with 102 measured samples per mode after 40 warmups for each author/window workload. Pooled summary uses all 204 measured samples per mode at the 8192-edit window. Both invocations run under bench-class admission without quiet mode. Prefix setup and real textbuffer author/apply are outside timing. The current implementation preserves canonical suffix references, adds only incoming causal entries, and removes only evicted map entries. No full detector-budget claim.

baselineStageProbe.qualification: experiment, shared machine; instrumentation overhead included
baselineStageProbe.method: Six performance.now differences inside baseline append. Markers at append entry, before combined ordering, before kept membership, before entry creation, before retained mapping, before candidate filtering, and before sequence commit. Record only calls with 100 incoming edits and 8192 retained entries. Mean over 426 calls, including warmups, across 2/4/8 authors. The new-causal-entries phase also scans retained entries to skip them.

runs.method: 100k-line TypeScript document. 100 independent confirmed replacements per batch, spread across 2/4/8 authors. Retained history is 100 or 8192 edits. 102 samples per mode after 40 warmups, in A/B/B/A order (A uses the baseline ConfirmedWindow module supplied through --compare, B uses the current build). Each prefix index is prepared outside timing. Append and exact pair output are timed separately. Real TextbufferEngine author/apply and validation outside timers. Final samples compare all retained edits and exact pairs against a fresh baseline window. Excludes parsing, merge-unit mapping and version reconstruction. No detector budget claim.
